text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems as though you and your<n>trainer have
gotten really in sync with<n>each other.

I-I wouldn't go so far as to say that!<n>Though I
guess training has been<n>going well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I guess she is always adjusting mytraining regimen to suit my needs andencouraging me when I don't feelconfident...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should put my gratitude into<n>words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just thinking about how well<n>things have
been going recently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It... it feels like my training is starting<n>to pay off,
maybe. And I, um, think my<n>regimen has been...
good for me.
choice_data_list: It's because you're working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know you have a lot to do with all<n>that, so... I just
wanted to say thank<n>you.
choice_data_list: It's because you're working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm working hard! Anyway,<n>um... Bye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can keep it up, and, um...<n>Anyway, I'm
going to go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober turns bright red and<n>runs away.
